name: characteristicPolynomial
notes: MathTS computes det(A - λI) sign convention; mathjs computes det(λI - A); coefficients differ in sign for odd-degree terms.

name: cholesky
notes: MathTS returns {L} object and checks symmetry; mathjs returns L directly without symmetry check.

name: hessenbergForm
notes: Both use Householder reflections; MathTS uses beta=2/normV formulation, mathjs normalizes v explicitly; results equivalent.

name: jordanForm
notes: No jordanForm implementation found in the MathTS file.

name: matrixLog
notes: MathTS uses inverse scaling-and-squaring with Taylor series; mathjs uses eigendecomposition directly.

name: matrixPower
notes: MathTS additionally supports fractional powers via eigendecomposition; mathjs only handles integer exponents.

name: matrixRank
notes: MathTS computes rank via RREF; mathjs uses SVD singular value thresholding.

name: nullSpace
notes: No nullSpace implementation found in the MathTS file.

name: polarDecomposition
notes: No polarDecomposition implementation found in the MathTS file.

name: rowReduce
notes: Both use Gauss-Jordan with partial pivoting; MathTS exposes tol parameter, mathjs hardcodes 1e-10.

name: svd
notes: MathTS delegates to external @danielsimonjr/mathts-matrix svd; no internal SVD implementation present.
